task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Take the cylindrical red drink can with logo in the right arm, place it into the basket for carrying things, another arm lifts the basket for carrying things.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架后，右臂拿起带标志的圆柱形红色饮料罐，将其放入提物篮中，另一臂提起提物篮。
